title: gtm-cs 1:1 prep - Olivia Hart & Avery Chen
content:
Purpose: quick 1:1 with Avery to align on top customer risks/opps, renewal cadence, and SE support priorities. Keep this lightweight; capture action items and blockers.

Agenda:
- Quick personal check-in (5m)
- Top 3 accounts to escalate this week (10m)
- Renewal pipeline + health updates (10m)
- SE/technical ask queue and priority (10m)
- Action items / owners / due dates (5m)

Notes / talking points:
1) Personal check-in
- Quick: Olivia out 3/25 for doctors appointment (happy to shift 1:1 if needed). Low-context FYI: onboarding new CSM hire next month.

2) Top accounts to escalate
- Acme (Strategic, ARR $1.2M): onboarding lagging; integration team reported memory pressure on private deployment last week. SE ask: Diego to validate quantized runtime config (see JIRA RWD-1452). Risk: if not resolved before pilot demo 3/30, customer may delay Phase 2 purchase.
- BrightBank (Finance vertical, ARR $420k): renewal 5/15; adoption healthy but cost spikes month over month. Need Optimize recommendation (batching + cache) and an exec sponsor intro.
- NeonHealth (Healthcare, ARR $320k): compliance checks in progress; Private deployment timeline slipped; legal asked for additional SOC2 artifacts.

3) Renewal pipeline + health
- 3 renewals in next 60 days: BrightBank (5/15, high touch), CoreRetail (6/01, low touch), MapleAI (6/20, negotiation ongoing).
- Metrics to call out: daily active users using embeddings down 12% MoM for BrightBank - need to understand if usage decline impacts value prop.
- Proposal: schedule a usage deep-dive with BrightBank next week (owner: Olivia) and prepare Optimize cost-savings proposal (owner: Avery).

4) SE / Technical queue
- Open tickets requiring SE time: RWD-1452 (Acme runtime tuning), RWD-1478 (BrightBank slow cold-starts), RWD-1499 (NeonHealth KMS config).
- Priority: RWD-1452 > RWD-1478 > RWD-1499 based on revenue/near-term demo dates.
- Diego: can you scope a 2-hour runbook for Acme (what we need to test + suggested config toggles)? Aim to have by 3/22.

5) Wins to call out in customer conversations
- Successful reduction in median p50 latency for hosted API after autoscaling tweak; anecdote from Internal testbed shows 18% reduction. Good PR for customers worried about latency.
- New Optimize recommendation templates: cost vs latency tradeoff matrix (link in Confluence).

6) Risks / blockers
- SE bandwidth: we have two high-priority tickets but only limited availability next week due to infra upgrade. Might need to escalate for dedicated capacity or propose scope reduction.
- Legal/compliance for Private: NeonHealth requested more evidence for SOC2 control mapping; ask legal for templated response (owner: Olivia to ping Legal).

Action items (explicit)
- Diego Ramirez: draft 2-hr Acme runtime runbook + list of test profiles. Due 2026-03-22. (JIRA RWD-1452)
- Avery Chen: prepare Optimize proposal (batching + cache) for BrightBank including expected monthly $ savings. Due 2026-03-24.
- Olivia Hart: schedule BrightBank usage deep-dive with customer and include Product (owner: Priya) + Diego. Proposed dates 3/24 or 3/25. Due: calendar invite by 2026-03-21.
- Olivia Hart: ping Legal for SOC2 artifact template and attach to NeonHealth thread. Due 2026-03-21.
- Avery Chen: ask for exec sponsor intro at BrightBank (internal contact: Tom W.) and share ask template. Due 2026-03-23.

Follow-ups for next 1:1
- Check Diego runbook status and confirm any infra scheduling needs.
- Review BrightBank deep-dive prep and finalize recommendation deck.
- Decide whether to escalate Acme to Dedicated capacity for demo if runbook can't reduce memory issues.

Loose notes / talking bullets to use in meeting with Acme
- "We saw memory pressure when you hit sustained batch sizes > 48 - Diego has a few config options (KV cache tuning, smaller batch windows) we can test during a quick session."
- "For BrightBank, we can model cost impact of enabling prefix caching at 75% hit-rate: rough calc attached in Optimize playbook."

References / links (paste into meeting chat)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CUST/Optimize-playbooks
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWD-1452
- Slack thread: #cust-acme-onboarding (search: "acme memory pressure")

Quick notes to self (scrappy)
- Keep 1:1 focused - no deep tech troubleshooting in this slot, just alignment and owners.
- If Diego blocked, propose short pairing session 3/23 with infra team (15-30m).
content_summary: 1:1 prep for OE: top accounts (Acme, BrightBank, NeonHealth), SE tickets, renewals, and clear action items with due dates. Focus on runbook for Acme and Optimize proposal for BrightBank.
